newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close lower on bluechips.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close lower on bluechips.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed lower on Tuesday on a wave of selling of blue-chip shares, dealers said.
Bogota's IBB index lost 1.01 percent, falling to 854.46 on a 1.17 billion trading volume. Medellin's IBOMED general price index drifted down 0.5 percent to 13,383.72 on a 547.3 million peso volume.

"There's no political or economic factors to motivate demand. Today investors were selling small volumes of those shares that had been under the strongest downward pressure of late," one Medellin broker said.
